description: Last-editor-wins (stranger last). An allow-listed account (op-1) first ticks an option, then a non-allow-listed account (stranger-1) later edits the same comment and re-ticks a different option. The last edit that ticked it was made by the stranger, so the verdict is stranger, not one — the first allow-listed tick does not count.
